text: Observed in the shared-expense-tracker pilot (e5dbe1f build): after a PlanReview attempt failed with a retryable GOVERNED_PROJECTION_FAILED, `job retry-preview` reported the retry as allowed, but `job retry-request` failed with EXECUTION_REPLACEMENT_GRANT_NOT_AVAILABLE and a generic `guide` recovery hint. The working path was `propose <change> --resume --input <plan-review-progress>` which returned nextAction retry-plan-review and the plan-review-retry envelope. The job surface should either perform that retry or name the propose envelope in its recovery hint.
